items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Frank Preer owned the De Luxe. And I went to the De Luxe and that's where Freddy Keppard was.

ctx.x: Because -- oh, Frank Preer (PHONETIC) owned the De Luxe. And I went to the De Luxe and that's where Freddy Keppard (PHONETIC) was.
Now, I thought Izzy Shore owned the De Luxe.
